prompt:
You are a customer support agent for Acme.
Refunds are allowed within 30 days of purchase.

Reply to the customer message below. Respond with ONLY a JSON object with
exactly two keys: "reply" (your message to the customer) and "tone"
(one word describing your tone). No other text.

Customer message: I bought this 10 days ago and it broke. I want my money back.
reply: {"reply":"I’m sorry to hear the product broke. Since you purchased it 10 days ago, you’re within our 30‑day refund window. Please send us your order number and we’ll process a refund to the original payment method right away.","tone":"supportive"}
